title: Plan-Based Requirement for Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Whether a service needs one of the **Referrals and Authorizations** depends on the plan the patient holds on the date of service, not on what the caller believes.

## The rule

- **Under TRICARE Prime**, non-emergency specialty care and rehabilitative therapy need a PCM referral, and care received without one falls under the outcome the authorization type sets for TRICARE Prime.
- **Under TRICARE Select and the premium-based plans** (the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans), only the services of authorization types that list TRICARE Select or the premium-based plans need an authorization, and care without one falls under the outcome the type sets for TRICARE Select and the premium-based plans.
- **Exempt services**: the service classes the type lists as exempt never need one (preventive care, emergency care, urgent care and office-based outpatient behavioral health visits).
- **Not required for the plan**: a request for a patient whose plan does not require that authorization is not reviewed for medical necessity; it is denied as not required for the plan, so that no unneeded authorization sits on the record.
- **No eligibility**: a request for a patient with no active TRICARE coverage on the request date is denied as no eligibility.

## Earlier enrollment clause (no longer in force)

> The patient holds an active enrollment in a plan listed in the type's list of plans under which the authorization is required, on the request date.

This clause, formerly checked before an approval against the patient's TRICARE Prime, TRICARE Select and premium-plan enrollment records, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Decision points

| Patient's situation on the relevant date | Outcome of the request |
|---|---|
| No active TRICARE coverage on the request date | denied as no eligibility |
| Plan does not require this authorization type | not reviewed for medical necessity; denied as not required for the plan |
| Service is in an exempt class | needs no authorization |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A patient enrolled in TRICARE Select asks for a Specialty Care Referral; the Specialty Care Referral is required under TRICARE Prime only, so the request is not reviewed for medical necessity and is denied as not required for the plan.

superseded_clauses: The patient holds an active enrollment in a plan listed in the tier's required_for_plans on the request date.
